articles.description: — Josh Allen ran for two touchdowns and threw a TD pass to DJ Moore, and the Buffalo Bills pulled away from the New York Jets for a 31-12 victory Sunday that has them off to their best start in 35 years.

articles.headline: Fantasy buzz: Week 10's leading scorers through Sunday's early games
articles.description: Kansas City rookie Emmett Johnson stepped in for Kenneth Walker III and was one of the top fantasy scorers of Week 10.

images.name: Emmett Johnson [1296x729]
images.caption: Emmett Johnson combined for 171 yards and two touchdowns against the Falcons.

images.name: Emmett Johnson [1296x729]
images.caption: Emmett Johnson takes over as Kansas City's lead back with Kenneth Walker III sidelined on Sunday.
images.alt: Emmett Johnson #10 of the Kansas City Chiefs runs with the ball in the fourth quarter of an NFL game between the New York Jets and Kansas City Chiefs on Nov 8, 2026 at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, MO.

images.name: Isaiah Likely for Buzz (261113) [1296x729]
images.caption: Isaiah Likely scored 27.7 fantasy points on Thursday night, his fourth game this season with at least 20 points and his fifth in which he was targeted at least 10 times.
images.alt: New York Giants tight end Isaiah Likely (9) runs the ball toward the end zone for a touchdown during the second half of an NFL football game against the Washington Commanders in East Rutherford, N.J.

images.name: Jonah Coleman [1296x729]
images.caption: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman is a priority fantasy trade target as he has taken over the Broncos backfield.
images.alt: Denver Broncos running back Jonah Coleman celebrates after scoring against the Carolina Panthers during the second half of an NFL football game in Charlotte, N.C., Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026.

images.name: Parker Washington [1296x729]
images.caption: Parker Washington of the Jacksonville Jaguars caught this ball for a touchdown.
images.alt: Jacksonville Jaguars wide receiver Parker Washington (11) catches a pass before running for a touchdown against the Baltimore Ravens during the first half of an NFL football game.

images.name: Malik Willis [1296x729]
images.caption: Malik Willis of the Miami Dolphins will miss at least the next four weeks.

images.name: James Cook III [576x324]
images.caption: James Cook III got the ball 31 times on Monday night, which was enough volume to have a solid fantasy outing.
images.alt: Buffalo Bills running back James Cook III (4) scores a touchdown at the end of a 5-yard run during the fourth quarter of a NFL game between the Minnesota Vikings and Buffalo Bills.

images.name: Puka Nacua for Buzz injury (261109) [1296x729]
images.caption: Puka Nacua was once again the focal point of the Rams passing attack on Sunday against the Commanders, catching 14 passes for 150 yards and a touchdown.  He was injured on a carry in the Rams' final offensive play of the game.
images.alt: Puka Nacua #12 of the Los Angeles Rams runs the ball against the Washington Commanders during the fourth quarter at Northwest Stadium on November 08, 2026 in Landover, Maryland.

images.name: Michael Wilson for Buzz injury (261109) [1296x729]
images.caption: Michael Wilson was the Cardinals' leading wide receiver through Week 9 with 51 catches, 546 yards and two touchdowns.  Trey McBride leads the team in all three of those categories.
images.alt: Michael Wilson #14 of the Arizona Cardinals warms up before a game against the Seattle Seahawks at Lumen Field on November 08, 2026 in Seattle, Washington.
